opening.argument: The creator promotes StrongBlock nodes as a route to passive income, stating that one node costs $6,340 and that operating one brings in $63 per day. The creator also says profits and cryptocurrency were put into the project to earn passive income, then tells viewers it is “Not too late to join, by the way.” The StrongBlock page presents node creation alongside earning rewards, reinforcing the pitch as an available opportunity. Although viewers are briefly advised to think before investing, that caveat does not undo the specific daily-return claim and direct invitation to join. Together, these statements present paid node returns as an opportunity for viewers to pursue.

citations.quote: I put several of my profits and the cryptos who go nowhere in this project there and it's like that at least I am able to work with a passive income
